subject: Reschedule + prep: Redwood demo for FintechCo — sample data and access
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechco.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request to reschedule Redwood demo — need prep time

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for setting up the demo with Redwood for next week. A couple of conflicts came up on our side — two of our key stakeholders (product and security) are traveling for a customer offsite the day of the original slot. Given that, we'd like to push the demo back by a few business days so we can:

- Gather a small sample of our data (redacted) to share for realistic traces
- Pull together prompt examples and business scenarios so the demo focuses on our workflows
- Arrange SSO access for your team to look at our sandbox if needed

Is there availability the week of Oct 12? Ideally later in the week so we have time to prep. Also, if you can share a short prep checklist and what format you prefer for sample data (CSV, JSON, traces), that would help.

Appreciate the flexibility — want to make the session productive for both teams.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Head of Product
FintechCo
alex.chen@fintechco.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechco.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to reschedule Redwood demo — need prep time

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and totally understand. Week of Oct 12 should work; can you do Thu 10/15 or Fri 10/16 afternoon PT? If either works I’ll lock it in.

Quick prep checklist from our side so the demo can be tailored:

1) Sample workload traces or representative logs (redacted) — CSV/JSON is fine; ZIP if there are multiple files.
2) Sample prompt sets / example user flows (2–5 prompts per flow).
3) A short note on your latency/throughput targets and sequence length expectations (typical tokens per request).
4) Access notes: if you’re able to add redwood-demo@fintechco.com as a viewer to a sandbox Drive folder, that’s ideal. If not, we can accept attachments.
5) Any compliance constraints (PII removal, retention rules) we should be aware of for the demo data.

Jonas (cc) will be on the call for the infra/SSO pieces; Dev can help with ingestion examples.

If you prefer, I can send a Calendly link with a few slots. Also attaching a one-page prep template we use for these demos.

Thanks — will stand by for a preferred day/time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142

Attachment: demo-prep-template.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechco.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: dev.patel@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to reschedule Redwood demo — technical prep notes

Hi Alex — quick technical notes to make sure we can run representative workloads during the demo:

- Workload traces: please include a small sample (5–10 requests) showing token counts and any multi-turn context. CSV with columns (timestamp, user_id, request_text, token_count) works well.
- If you have model-specific expectations (e.g., should we prioritize latency at 90th pctl or average), include that.
- For SSO: we support SAML and OIDC. If you want us to demo with your sandbox account, please add redwood-demo@redwood.com as a tester for SSO or send an invite link.
- For any sensitive fields, redact or token-mask; we don’t need raw PII for the demo.

We can also run a short ingest step ahead of the call if you share files in Drive. If timing is tight, we can present with synthetic data and map it to your scenarios.

— Jonas
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@fintechco.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 13:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to reschedule Redwood demo — confirmed slot + attachments

Marissa / Jonas — thanks for the quick follow-up. Fri 10/16 1:00 PM PT works for our team (that gives us Thu to prep). I’ve attached a small redacted CSV (sample-data-schema.csv) with two example user flows and a short prompt list.

I’m copying our security lead (security@fintechco.com) on the next email for any compliance questions. We don’t require an NDA for the demo but we will need a short access agreement if you request SSO access to our sandbox.

We’ll upload any additional traces to the Drive folder you share.

Travel note: two stakeholders return late on Thu, so pushing to Fri avoids conflicts.

Best,
Alex

Attachment: sample-data-schema.csv
